key_notes: Key 1 (t=3.48s): Initial archival pose of carrot; Quick, Draw! + Rotoscope centerline established.

Key 3 (t=5.84s): Peak dynamic extension of carrot over 7-plane multiplane environment.
Key 4 (t=7.08s): Follow-through and settle of carrot with watertight SAM cel backing.
why_continuous: Continuous 3.6s archival shot of carrot (3.48s..7.08s) selected by edge clarity and temporal coherence.
